blocks.label: C-N (Pd/Cu/Ni)
blocks.panel_source: out/kit_members.csv, selected on the analysed pairs only

predictions.note: computed on the array's own analysed pairs with the same transported panel; in-sample, so the new pairs are expected to fall at or below these values

criteria.design: The manuscript's own six- and twelve-condition panels, selected on the analysed pairs, are applied unchanged to substrate pairs of the same array that no analysis has read. No panel is refitted, so no tie-break rule can affect the result.

endpoints.T1_retention: R_k = sum of best-in-panel over the new pairs / sum of best-over-the-array, k = 6 and 12
endpoints.T2_hit_recovery: among new pairs whose array best is at least 0.20, the share whose best within the six is at least 0.20
endpoints.T3_severe_loss: among new pairs whose array best exceeds 0, the share losing more than 0.20 absolute yield, k = 6 and 12

outcomes_fixed_in_advance.supports: T1 at k=6 at or above 0.60 and T2 at or above 0.70
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.does_not_support: T1 below 0.60 or T2 below 0.70; the manuscript then reports the shortfall in the abstract
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.rationale: The array's cross-validated R6 in the manuscript is 0.71, the lowest of the eighteen, and its severe-loss rate 38.5%, the highest. Thresholds are set below the in-sample values because new pairs are unseen, and above the value a random six-condition panel reaches on this array (0.39 in Table 1).

rules: Eligibility used measurement presence and the platform validation flag only; no yield value was read.
Pairs scored under freeze 1 are excluded.
No pair, condition or endpoint may be added, dropped or redefined after scoring begins.
Pairs whose array best is zero contribute to neither T2 nor T3 and are counted separately.
The 0.70-coverage set is a sensitivity analysis only. Its array best comes from fewer conditions, which can only raise measured retention, so it is an upper bound and is reported as one.
